judged_text: The new form adds <label for="name"> but {{text-field name="name"}} renders an input whose id is Ember's generated emberNNN, so the for attribute references an id that no element has. Clicking the Name label does nothing and assistive technology cannot associate the label with its input — the new markup asserts an association the rendered DOM does not provide.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs`, the new markup introduces `<label for="name">` but the corresponding `{{text-field name="name" value=name ...}}` does not pass an `id` attribute. In Ember, `name=` sets the input’s `name` attribute, while the `id` defaults to an auto-generated `ember###` unless explicitly provided. The diff therefore creates a label `for` target (`name`) that will not match any element id, breaking click-to-focus and label association for assistive tech.
